# @effected/toml constructs

| Construct | Kind | Purpose | Reach for it when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Toml` | Class | Static entry points for TOML parsing, stringification and the schema factories. Not instantiable. | |
| `TomlArray` | Class | An array value node. Heterogeneous per TOML; may span multiple lines (the span covers brackets, inner newlines and inner comments). | |
| `TomlArrayTableHeader` | Class | A `[[array-of-tables]]` header expression. Span contract as in {@link TomlKeyValue}. | |
| `TomlBoolean` | Class | A boolean value node. | |
| `TomlBoundCodec` | Interface | A domain codec pre-bound to its two directions, returned by {@link Toml.bind}: the composed `schema` (what {@link Toml.schema} returns) plus `decode` and `encode` functions derived from it once, so callers need no generic `Schema` machinery at the use site. | |
| `TomlDateTimeLiteral` | Class | A date-time value node wrapping one of the four TOML date-time classes. | |
| `TomlDiagnostic` | Class | One structured diagnostic: its {@link (TomlErrorCode:type)}, a human-readable `message`, and its exact position (`offset`/`length`, plus zero-based `line`/`character`). | |
| `TomlDocument` | Class | A parsed TOML document that never loses a byte: the `source` text, the linear {@link (TomlExpression:type)} CST whose spans tile the source exactly, and any semantic violations as {@link TomlDiagnostic} data. | |
| `TomlEdit` | Class | A non-mutating text edit: replace the span `[offset, offset + length)` with `content`. Set `length` to `0` to insert, `content` to `""` to delete. | |
| `TomlErrorCode` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all TOML error code string literals. | |
| `TomlExpression` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all expression node types. | |
| `TomlFloat` | Class | A float value node, including the special spellings (`inf`, `nan`). | |
| `TomlFormat` | Class | Formatting and modification statics. Not instantiable. | |
| `TomlFormattingOptions` | Class | Options controlling formatting and modification behavior. The only knob is `newline`: for `format` it normalizes every newline outside multi-line strings; for `modify` it overrides the dominant newline inherited by inserted lines. | |
| `TomlInlineEntry` | Class | One `key = value` entry inside an inline table. `keyPath` has more than one element for dotted keys (`{a.b = 1}`). | |
| `TomlInlineTable` | Class | An inline table value node (`{ k = v, ... }`). May span multiple lines since TOML 1.1 (the span covers braces, inner newlines and inner comments). | |
| `TomlInteger` | Class | An integer value node. Decodes to `number` when the magnitude fits in 2^53 - 1, else `bigint` (TOML integers span the full signed 64-bit range). | |
| `TomlKey` | Class | One simple key within a (possibly dotted) key path. | |
| `TomlKeyKind` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all key-kind string literals. | |
| `TomlKeyValue` | Class | A `key = value` expression. The span starts at the first character of the line's leading whitespace and ends after the terminating newline (or at EOF); multi-line values extend it. `comment` holds the decoded trailing comment (without `#`, one leading space stripped) when present. | |
| `TomlLexErrorCode` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all lexer-stage error code string literals. | |
| `TomlLocalDate` | Class | A TOML local date: `year`-`month`-`day` with no time-of-day or offset, validated against the real Gregorian calendar. | |
| `TomlLocalDateTime` | Class | A TOML local date-time: a {@link TomlLocalDate} and a {@link TomlLocalTime} combined, with no offset. | |
| `TomlLocalTime` | Class | A TOML local time: `hour`:`minute`:`second`[.`nanosecond`] with no date or offset. `second` tolerates the RFC 3339 leap second (0-60). | |
| `TomlModificationError` | Class | Raised when `TomlFormat.modify` cannot resolve the requested path against the document's semantic view, when the insertion target refuses (an inline table or an implicitly created table), or when the replacement value cannot render as TOML. Carries one structured {@link TomlDiagnostic} — never a collapsed `reason` string. | |
| `TomlOffsetDateTime` | Class | A TOML offset date-time: a {@link TomlLocalDateTime} plus `offsetMinutes` (-1439-1439). Parsing enforces `hh <= 23` / `mm <= 59` before construction; this class only bounds the combined minute count. | |
| `TomlParseError` | Class | Parse failure: the {@link TomlDiagnostic} entries describing why the document was rejected (first violation wins, so there is one today; the array shape matches `@effected/yaml`'s aggregate contract). Raised by {@link Toml.parse} and the decode direction of the schema factories. | |
| `TomlParseErrorCode` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all parser-stage error code string literals. | |
| `TomlPath` | TypeAlias | An ordered sequence of {@link TomlSegment} values describing a location within a TOML document's semantic tree. | |
| `TomlRange` | Class | A range within a TOML document, expressed as a zero-based character `offset` and a `length` in UTF-16 code units. Pass to `TomlFormat.format` to restrict formatting to the expressions intersecting a region. | |
| `TomlRangeLike` | TypeAlias | A range accepted at the `format`/`formatToString` call sites: either a {@link TomlRange} instance or a plain `{ offset, length }` literal (the two are structurally interchangeable — only `offset`/`length` are read). | |
| `TomlSegment` | TypeAlias | A single path segment: a `string` for table keys or a `number` for array and array-of-tables indices. | |
| `TomlSemanticErrorCode` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all semantic-stage error code string literals. | |
| `TomlString` | Class | A string value node. `value` is the decoded text; the raw spelling lives in the source span. | |
| `TomlStringStyle` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all string-style literals. | |
| `TomlStringifyError` | Class | Stringification failure: an unsupported value, an out-of-range integer, a circular reference or a tripped depth guard, as one structured {@link TomlDiagnostic} (offset `0` — there is no source text). Raised by {@link Toml.stringify} and the encode direction of the schema factories. | |
| `TomlStringifyErrorCode` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all stringifier-stage error code string literals. | |
| `TomlStringifyOptions` | Class | Options controlling stringify behavior. The only knob is `newline` — omitted, it resolves to `"\n"`. | |
| `TomlTableHeader` | Class | A `[table]` header expression. Span contract as in {@link TomlKeyValue}. | |
| `TomlTrivia` | Class | A run of consecutive blank and comment-only lines, coalesced into one expression. `text` is the raw source slice, newlines included. | |
| `TomlValueNode` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all TOML value node types. | |
| `TomlVisitor` | Class | SAX-style TOML visitor statics. Not instantiable. | |
| `TomlVisitorEvent` | Variable + TypeAlias | The discriminated union of TOML visitor events, in document order. `TableStart` fires once for the root with `path: []` before any other event, then again for every `[table]` header. `ArrayTableStart` fires for every `[[array]]` header with the 0-based element `index`. `KeyValue.path` includes the final key. `Comment` covers both standalone (trivia) and trailing comments — see the module remarks for `offset`'s exact meaning. | |
